function.name: product_list_retrieve
function.description: Retrieve a list of all xVG product names available in the catalog. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

category.description: The category filter to list products from specific categories only.

availability.description: A flag to filter products based on availability. When true, only products in stock are listed.

sort_order.description: The order in which the products should be sorted in the list. Possible values are ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

limit.description: The maximum number of product names to retrieve.

function.name: get_business_unit_mapping
function.description: Retrieve the mapping of business unit IDs (bu_id) to their corresponding names (bu_name) for all business units. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: product_selector_get_products
function.description: Retrieves a list of products for use in the SLA Dashboard and Patch Self Service, with an option to filter by anchor status. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

anchor.description: Filter to indicate if the retrieved products should be all products, user-associated products, or anchor products. Use 'all' for all products, 'user' for products associated with the current user, and 'anchor' for anchor products.

function.name: sce_api_get_products
function.description: Retrieve a list of products that have Service Level Agreement (SLA) metrics tracking enabled. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

anchor.description: Filter to indicate if the returned products should be all products, only those assigned to the user, or only anchor products. 'all' returns every product with SLA enabled, 'user' returns user-specific products, and 'anchor' returns products marked as anchors.

function.name: product_volume_get_active_branches
function.description: Retrieves active branches for a specific product within a given date range. Each product is represented by a unique ID, and branches are considered active if they fall within the specified date range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

crm_id.description: The unique Synopsys product ID assigned to this product.

days.description: The number of days from the current date to calculate the active volume products. For example, specifying 30 would retrieve products active in the last 30 days.

end_date.description: The end date up to which valid volume products should be retrieved, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

function.name: sce_api_get_product_information
function.description: Retrieve information for a specific product from the Synopsys Customer Entitlement (SCE) system using the product's CRM ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

crm_id.description: The unique identifier for Synopsys products.

fields.description: Comma-separated names of the product info fields to retrieve, such as 'name,version,status'.
